verses: I also saw the soul of a woman who ever wept, and ever tore and ate the skin and flesh from her own breasts.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who ever left her own infant crying on account of want and hunger.'
